mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used in custom tiny home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom tiny homes utilize a variety of materials, prioritizing durability, insulation, and weight efficiency. Common exterior materials include wood siding (cedar, pine), metal siding, or composite panels, often paired with energy-efficient windows and doors. Interior finishes range from lightweight plywood or shiplap for walls to compact, multi-functional cabinetry made from sustainable wood. Insulation is typically high-performance, such as spray foam or rigid foam, to maximize energy efficiency in a small footprint. Material selection is tailored to your aesthetic preferences and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include wood or metal siding, energy-efficient windows, lightweight interior finishes, and high-performance insulation to balance durability, efficiency, and weight.
